ElementDescription: The NDAR Global Unique Identifier (GUID) for research subject
Subject ID how it's defined in lab/project
Date on which the interview/genetic test/sampling/imaging/biospecimen was completed. MM/DD/YYYY
Age in months at the time of the interview/test/sampling/imaging.
Notes: Age is rounded to chronological month. If the research participant is 15-days-old at time of interview, the appropriate value would be 0 months. If the participant is 16-days-old, the value would be 1 month.
M = Male; F = Female; O=Other; NR = Not reported
e.g., Self-Report, Parent Form, Short Form, Revised Version, Other Informant Form

ElementDescription: Ran errands and shopped in stores. How much support? (Use: Proxy and Self-Report)
Notes: 0=Was unable to do, even with support; 1=A lot of support; 2=Some support; 3=A little support; 4=Was able to do without any support

ElementDescription: Got around safely in the community (for example, across parking lots, not walking in street). How much support? (Use: Proxy and Self-Report)
Notes: 0=Was unable to do, even with support; 1=A lot of support; 2=Some support; 3=A little support; 4=Was able to do without any support

ElementDescription: Found a way to get places that are not close by. How much support? (Use: Proxy and Self-Report)

ElementDescription: Understood and followed traffic signs and signals when getting around or driving. How much support? (Use: Proxy version only)
Notes: 0=Was unable to do, even with support; 1=A lot of support; 2=Some support; 3=A little support; 4=Was able to do without any support

ElementDescription: Mobility Support - Simple sum of 4 items (reals_mob_ps_supp1, reals_mob_ps_supp2, reals_mob_ps_supp3, reals_mob_p_supp4) (Use: Proxy version only)
Notes: Sum of items reals_mob_ps_supp1-3, reals_mob_p_supp4; -9=Score missing due to missing items; Low score value = high need for mobility support; high score value = no need for mobility support

ElementDescription: Theta value for reals_mob_p_total  (Use: Proxy version only)
Notes: Low score value = lowest theta; high score value = highest theta

ElementDescription: Standard deviation for reals_mob_p_freq_total  (Use: Proxy version only)
Notes: Low score value = less variability; high score value = more variability

ElementDescription: Mobility Support - Simple sum of 3 items (reals_mob_ps_supp1, reals_mob_ps_supp2, reals_mob_ps_supp3) (Use: Self-Report version only)
